verdict.rationale: Codegen documents an official Python SDK with concrete usage examples (agent.run) plus a REST-style API reference (agent runs, logs, CI/CD triggers) and an official CLI, all under docs.codegen.com — clear evidence of official SDK-based programmatic access for AI-native builders. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI spec found (probe returned 404s) and no independent/third-party corroboration of SDK reliability beyond vendor docs.
